items.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
items.summary: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.

items.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
items.summary: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

items.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
items.summary: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 16, 2026

items.title: Circle targets 40 new markets as stablecoin demand grows globally
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s CEO Jerermy Allaire told Reuters demand for digital dollars is growing across Asia, Africa and Latin America as banks and payment firms.

items.title: Tokenized Tesla surges as Elon Musk unveils SpaceX-powered flying Roadster prototype
items.summary: Volume in Hyperliquid’s Tesla contract hit $47 million in one hour after Elon Musk’s flying Roadster demo, up from $2.8 million, with U.S. stocks closed.

items.title: Altcoins outpace bitcoin as celestia jumps 16%, Warsh silent on interest-rate plans
items.summary: Celestia jumped 16%, injective rose 7.7% and layerzero added 7.3% while bitcoin held little changed near $82,100 and Fed Chair Warsh gave no sign on interest rates.

items.title: Scammer gets scammed in Ledger spy-chip exploit, loses almost $5 million in bitcoin
items.summary: Chainalysis says a fraudster who tricked people through fake online jobs became one of the biggest victims of the compromised hardware wallets.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin steady near $82,000 after Fed Chair Warsh's comments
items.summary: Crypto held to its bounce following bitcoin’s brief drop under $80,000, but investors kept pulling money from ether, SOL and ZEC funds.

items.title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
items.summary: The crypto exchange already paid up, but a court order and restrictions from its 2025 settlement will not be lifted even though the CFTC said the case should have never been presented.

items.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
items.summary: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

items.title: XRP has failed to make holders rich like bitcoin and ether. Here’s why
items.summary: XRP remains below its 2017-cycle high while bitcoin, ether and other major tokens have surged, enriching their holders.

items.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
items.summary: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

items.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.

items.title: Solana’s Liu says Shanghai event postponed over registration surge
items.summary: Solana Foundation President Lily Liu said registrations quadrupled overnight, exceeding the attendance limit registered with local authorities.

items.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
items.summary: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.

items.title: Bitcoin may seek 20-month trend line reclaim before new record highs: CryptoQuant
items.summary: Bitcoin’s market cycle signals tool showed BTC price action copying history, possibly preparing to reclaim a key moving average before testing new highs.

items.title: Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
items.summary: Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.

items.title: Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to undo $5M settlement
items.summary: Judge ruled changes in CFTC enforcement priorities and allegations of misconduct by its enforcement division were insufficient to overturn Gemini’s January 2025 settlement.
